title: Exploratory: similarity scorer with near-duplicate text
objective: Find scoring surprises that fixed test data cannot predict.
preconditions: App reachable. Time box: 60 minutes. Note anything unexpected as you go.

steps.action: Submit a corpus sentence with every word capitalised and extra punctuation.
steps.expected: Still scores 100% and is flagged.

steps.action: Submit the same sentence with curly quotes, accented letters and non-breaking spaces.
steps.expected: Score is explainable; no error.

steps.action: Submit a corpus sentence with one word changed every five words.
steps.expected: Score drops sharply; decide whether that is acceptable evasion.

steps.action: Submit text in another language or script, including right-to-left.
steps.expected: 0% and clear; table renders correctly.

steps.action: Submit text just under and just over the 25% threshold.
steps.expected: Status flips exactly at 25%.

title: Exploratory: abuse the web form
objective: Try to break the form the way a careless or hostile user would.

steps.action: Paste 20,000 characters, then 20,001.
steps.expected: First accepted, second rejected with a clear message.

steps.action: Double-click and rapidly re-click the submit button.
steps.expected: No duplicate rows beyond what was genuinely submitted.

steps.action: Submit, press Back, then resubmit.
steps.expected: No error page; behaviour is understandable.

steps.action: Use emoji, very long single words and pasted rich text.
steps.expected: Stored and shown as plain text; layout holds.

steps.action: Open the form in two tabs and submit from both.
steps.expected: Both submissions appear.

title: Cross-browser check: Firefox and Safari
objective: The automated UI suite runs in Chromium only.
preconditions: Latest Firefox and Safari on desktop.

steps.action: Load the home page in each browser.
steps.expected: Layout matches Chrome: header, form card, overview, table.

steps.action: Submit one clear and one flagged paper in each.
steps.expected: Coloured score badge and status pill render; confirmation message appears.

steps.action: Trigger validation errors in each.
steps.expected: Error summary appears and takes focus.

steps.action: Resize to phone width.
steps.expected: Single column; table scrolls inside its card.

title: Screen reader pass with VoiceOver on macOS
objective: Automated checks prove the right markup exists; only listening shows whether it makes sense.
preconditions: Safari. Turn VoiceOver on with Cmd+F5.

steps.action: Load the page and listen to the first announcement.
steps.expected: Page title, then the skip link.

steps.action: Navigate the form with VO+Right.
steps.expected: Each field is announced with its label and that it is required.

steps.action: Submit the empty form.
steps.expected: "There is a problem" and each error are read without hunting for them.

steps.action: Follow an error link.
steps.expected: Focus lands in the field and its error is read.

steps.action: Submit a valid paper.
steps.expected: The confirmation, with score and status, is read.

steps.action: Navigate the results table with VO table commands.
steps.expected: Caption and column headers are read with each cell.

title: Screen reader pass with NVDA on Windows
objective: NVDA with Firefox or Chrome is the most common free combination; behaviour differs from VoiceOver.
preconditions: Windows machine or VM with NVDA installed.

steps.action: Repeat the six steps of TC-MAN-004 with NVDA.
steps.expected: Same information is announced at each step.

steps.action: Open the elements list (NVDA+F7) and review landmarks and headings.
steps.expected: Regions have distinct names; one level-1 heading.

title: Voice control: operate the form by speaking
objective: Controls must be activatable by their visible names.
preconditions: macOS Voice Control enabled in System Settings, Accessibility.

steps.action: Say "Click Title", dictate a title, and repeat for Author and Paper text.
steps.expected: Each field is targeted by its visible label.

steps.action: Say "Click Check similarity".
steps.expected: The form submits.

title: Plain-language review of instructions and error messages
objective: Wording should be understandable without technical knowledge.

steps.action: Read every label, hint and error message aloud.
steps.expected: Each says what is wrong and how to fix it, in everyday words.

steps.action: Read the accessibility statement.
steps.expected: Honest, specific and free of jargon.

title: Real-device check on an iPhone
objective: Device emulation cannot reproduce a real touch keyboard, zoom or Safari's toolbar.
preconditions: An iPhone with Safari. The Appium test for this is not yet run.

steps.action: Open the live URL.
steps.expected: No sideways page scrolling; text readable without zoom.

steps.action: Fill in the form with the on-screen keyboard.
steps.expected: Fields are not hidden by the keyboard; no unwanted zoom on focus.

steps.action: Submit and scroll the results table sideways.
steps.expected: Row appears; table scrolls within its card.

steps.action: Rotate to landscape.
steps.expected: Layout adapts.

title: Load test at 50 users against a deployed environment
objective: The pipeline runs 20 users locally. The agreed criterion is at 50 users on real infrastructure.
preconditions: Agree the run with whoever pays the AWS bill. Use the submission-service-aws-ci stack, never the primary one.

steps.action: Run JMeter with 50 users, 30 s ramp, 120 s duration against the stack's URL.
steps.expected: Completes.

steps.action: Read the dashboard.
steps.expected: p95 under 500 ms for POST; error rate under 0.5%; throughput over 100 requests a second.

steps.action: Check the Lambda error alarm and DynamoDB throttling metrics.
steps.expected: No alarm; no throttled requests.

title: Recovery drill: restore the table from a point in time
objective: Point-in-time recovery is enabled and asserted by a test, but a backup is only proven by restoring it.
preconditions: AWS console access. Use the submission-service-aws-ci stack.

steps.action: Create three submissions and note the time.
steps.expected: Visible in the app.

steps.action: Delete them, then in DynamoDB choose Restore to point in time, to a new table, at the noted time.
steps.expected: Restore completes.

steps.action: Inspect the restored table.
steps.expected: The three items are present and intact.

steps.action: Delete the restored table.
steps.expected: No leftover cost.

title: Alerting drill: the error alarm fires
objective: A test confirms the alarm exists and is quiet. This confirms it can fire.
preconditions: AWS console access. Use the submission-service-aws-ci stack.

steps.action: In the Lambda console, set the function's SUBMISSIONS_TABLE variable to a table that does not exist.
steps.expected: Saved.

steps.action: Call the API a few times.
steps.expected: Responses are 500 with a generic JSON error and no internal detail.

steps.action: Watch the CloudWatch alarm for up to five minutes.
steps.expected: State changes to In alarm.

steps.action: Re-run the pipeline to restore the configuration.
steps.expected: Alarm returns to OK.

title: Release sign-off checklist
objective: A person, not a pipeline, accepts the release.
preconditions: All pipelines green on the release commit.

steps.action: Confirm no open severity 1 or 2 defects in Jira.
steps.expected: None open.

steps.action: Confirm all P1 manual cases in this plan have a result.
steps.expected: No P1 case is still "not run".

steps.action: Review the accepted risks in docs/12_security.md with the product owner.
steps.expected: Risks explicitly accepted or scheduled.

steps.action: Record the decision here with your name.
steps.expected: Result saved.
